# Loading Libraries and Data

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(sva)
library(reshape2)

data <- load("SKCM.rda")

fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")

log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)
```



```{r}
ids <- as.character(colData(query2)$barcode)
batch <- sapply(strsplit(ids, "-"), function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 6) return(x[6]) else return(NA)
})


gene_var <- apply(log_expr, 1, var)
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr[gene_var > 0, ]
```

# Distribution Before Batch Correction

```{r}
# Add batch info
expr_long_before <- melt(log_expr_filtered)
colnames(expr_long_before) <- c("Gene", "Sample", "Expression")

# Map batch information to each sample
expr_long_before$Batch <- batch[match(expr_long_before$Sample, colnames(log_expr_filtered))]

ggplot(expr_long_before, aes(x = Batch, y = Expression, fill = Batch)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Expression Distribution by Batch (Before Batch Correction)",
    x = "Batch",
    y = "log2(FPKM + 1)"
  )

```


# PCA Before Batch Correction

```{r}
pca_raw <- prcomp(t(log_expr_filtered), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df_raw <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_raw$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_raw$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca_raw$x[, 3],
  PC4 = pca_raw$x[, 4],
  batch = batch
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## PC1 vs PC2

```{r}
ggplot(pca_df_raw, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Before Batch Correction", x = "PC1", y = "PC2")

```

## PC2 vs PC3

```{r}
ggplot(pca_df_raw, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Before Batch Correction", x = "PC2", y = "PC3")

```

## PC3 vs PC4

```{r}
ggplot(pca_df_raw, aes(x = PC3, y = PC4, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Before Batch Correction", x = "PC3", y = "PC4")

```

:::

# PCA After Batch Correction

```{r}
# ComBat 
modcombat <- model.matrix(~1, data = data.frame(batch = batch))
combat_expr <- ComBat(dat = as.matrix(log_expr_filtered),
                      batch = batch,
                      mod = modcombat,
                      par.prior = TRUE,
                      prior.plots = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# PCA
pca_corrected <- prcomp(t(combat_expr), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df_corrected <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_corrected$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_corrected$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca_corrected$x[, 3],
  PC4 = pca_corrected$x[, 4],
  batch = batch
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## PC1 vs PC2

```{r}
ggplot(pca_df_corrected, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA After Batch Correction", x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
```

## PC2 vs PC3

```{r}
ggplot(pca_df_corrected, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA After Batch Correction", x = "PC2", y = "PC3")
```

## PC3 vs PC4

```{r}
ggplot(pca_df_corrected, aes(x = PC3, y = PC4, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA After Batch Correction", x = "PC3", y = "PC4")
```

:::

# Distribution After Batch Correction

```{r}
expr_long_after <- melt(combat_expr)
colnames(expr_long_after) <- c("Gene", "Sample", "Expression")

# Map batch info the same way
expr_long_after$Batch <- batch[match(expr_long_after$Sample, colnames(combat_expr))]

ggplot(expr_long_after, aes(x = Batch, y = Expression, fill = Batch)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Expression Distribution by Batch (After Batch Correction)",
    x = "Batch",
    y = "log2(FPKM + 1)"
  )

```
